summary: Comprehensive testing of Dossier Express IA workflow fixes: admin-bypass creates premium_analyses, full-content endpoint, tab separation, stepper visibility, and sessionStorage persistence. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working.
seed_data_creation: Created test dossiers via admin-bypass endpoint during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 blocking corrections verified working: 1) Admin-bypass creates premium_analyses entry on completion (verified via API tests), 2) StrategiIA and Dossier Express tabs are properly separated (StrategiIA tab shows only strategiia items, Dossier Express tab shows only dossier_express items), 3) Stepper is visible after form submission - page scrolls to top (scroll position = 0) and shows 5 dynamic steps with progress bar. The 'Consulter l'analyse' button opens dialog with full analysis text. The 'Relire/Valider' workflow opens review dialog with editable textarea.

backend: POST /api/dossier-express/admin-bypass - creates dossier and premium_analyses entry
GET /api/dossier-express/status/{id} - returns dossier status with progress_step
GET /api/admin/premium-analyses - returns list with stats, includes both types
GET /api/admin/premium-analyses/{id}/full-content - returns analysis from dossier_express collection
GET /api/admin/dossier-express/{id}/analysis - returns complete analysis for specific dossier
PATCH /api/admin/premium-analyses/{id} - changes status correctly (en_attente -> en_cours -> valide)
POST /api/admin/premium-analyses/{id}/send-reviewed - sends reviewed analysis, changes status to envoye
GET /api/admin/dossier-express - returns list with production stats
frontend: Admin Dashboard loads with StrategiIA and Dossier Express tabs
StrategiIA tab shows ONLY strategiia type premium items
Dossier Express tab shows ONLY dossier_express type premium items
Dossier Express tab shows production stats (Total: 39, Terminés: 16, En cours: 2, Erreurs: 21)
Dossier Express tab shows premium review stats (Total: 10, En attente: 6, En cours: 3, Validé: 0, Envoyé: 1)
'Traiter' button changes item status to en_cours
'Relire / Valider' button opens review dialog with full analysis text
'Consulter l'analyse' button opens dialog with full analysis for completed dossiers
Admin mode toggle uses sessionStorage for persistence
Dossier Express form shows 'Lancer l'analyse StratégiIA' after admin bypass
After launching analysis, page scrolls to top (scroll position = 0)
Stepper shows 5 dynamic steps with progress bar
Processing view shows 'Analyse en cours...' with email confirmation
